summary: Iteration 3 features tested: /api/stats/recap endpoint (days & season filters) and frontend Recap page, Matches search, and ChampionPortrait rendering. All core checks passed.
passed: GET /api/stats/recap?days=7 returns full structure (period_days=7, total_matches=29, 8 climbers, 5 upsets, 12 trends) with all required fields (player_id/name/delta/matches/wins/winrate; winners/losers/mmr_gap/round_margin/score; champion/role/picks/wins/winrate)
GET /api/stats/recap?days=1 returns valid structure (HTTP 200) — all 29 seeded matches within last day
GET /api/stats/recap?season_id=<ephemeral> returns valid empty result (total=0, climbers=0, trends=0)
Login with admin@arenaops.gg/admin123 succeeds (auth cookie set, subsequent pages accessible)
/recap page loads with data-testid=recap-page; recap-days, recap-season, recap-print all visible; 8 climber rows, 5 upset rows, 12 trend cards rendered
/matches has matches-search input; typing 'Bakko' filters 87 -> 18 rows; gibberish -> 0; empty restores to 87

ChampionPortrait hex emblems render on /champions with role-color coding (screenshot confirms Ja=red melee, Va=cyan ranged, Pe=green support, etc.) — 14 SVG portraits on champions page, 72 on matches page
nav-recap link present in Layout nav

failed.issue: Login button redirects to '/' rather than '/dashboard'. User is still authenticated and dashboard-content is reachable via nav; not a functional blocker.
failed.evidence: Playwright wait_for_url('**/dashboard**') timed out; navigated to '/'. Subsequent nav to /recap, /matches, /champions works as admin.

action_items: Optional: after successful login, navigate() explicitly to /dashboard for consistency with test expectations.
